raw_input:
The user login system shall allow registered users to log in using
email and password. The system shall lock the account after 3
consecutive failed login attempts. Password must be minimum 8
characters with at least one uppercase, one number, and one special
character. The system shall send a password reset email within
2 minutes of request. Session shall expire after 30 minutes of
inactivity.

requirements.text: Allow registered users to log in using email and password.
Lock user account after 3 consecutive failed login attempts.
Enforce password rules: minimum 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number, 1 special char.
Send password reset email within 2 minutes of request.
Expire user session after 30 minutes of inactivity.

business_rules.name: Account Lockout Policy
business_rules.description: Lock account on the 3rd consecutive failed attempt. Reset attempt counter on success.

business_rules.name: Password Strength Criteria
business_rules.description: Passwords must have >= 8 chars, >= 1 uppercase letter, >= 1 numeric digit, and >= 1 special character.

business_rules.name: Inactivity Timeout
business_rules.description: Sessions expire after 30 minutes of no user activity.

validations.rule: Ensure email matches standard format and password matches database hash.
Increment failed_attempts on failure. If failed_attempts >= 3, set status to LOCKED.
Verify password input contains 8+ characters, uppercase, number, and special character.

assumptions: Account status resets to active after a password reset or admin intervention.
Inactivity is defined as no HTTP/API requests from the client session.
ambiguities: How long does the account remain locked? Is it a timed lockout or indefinite until reset?
What special characters are permitted in the password?

TC-001.script:
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

def test_user_login():
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = browser.new_page()
        page.goto('https://example.com/login')
        page.fill('input[type="email"]', 'qa_tester@example.com')
        page.fill('input[type="password"]', 'P@ssword1')
        page.click('button[type="submit"]')
        # Assert redirection
        page.wait_for_url('https://example.com/dashboard')
        assert page.url == 'https://example.com/dashboard'
        browser.close()

TC-002.script:
import pytest
import requests

def test_account_lockout():
    # Step 1-3: Consecutive failed attempts
    url = 'https://example.com/api/auth/login'
    for i in range(3):
        res = requests.post(url, json={'email': 'qa_tester@example.com', 'password': f'WrongPass{i}'})
        assert res.status_code == 401
        assert 'Invalid credentials' in res.json()['message']

    # Step 4: Correct password attempt should fail due to lockout
    res = requests.post(url, json={'email': 'qa_tester@example.com', 'password': 'P@ssword1'})
    assert res.status_code == 423
    assert 'Account is locked' in res.json()['message']
